title: Grassmannian Geometry and Global Convergence of Variable Projection for Neural Networks
summary: Training deep neural networks and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) often leads to ill-conditioned and stiff optimization problems. A key structural feature of these models is that they are linear in the output-layer parameters and nonlinear in the hiddenlayer parameters, yielding a separable nonlinear least-squares formulation. In this work, we study the classical variable projection (VarPro) method for such problems in the context of deep neural networks.
